pieces.Text: You possess a pair of flexible crystalline tentacles with which you can drain a creature's sense of fate and destiny. Whenever you strikes a foe with these tentacles, the creature struck must make a DC

Will save or take 1d4 points of Charisma damage. Until a creature's Charisma damage from this ability is healed, the victim takes a -2 penalty on all saving throws (regardless of the actual total amount of Charisma damage it takes).
